summary: Image optimization audit complete across 8 Spanish public routes (home, /viajes, destination hub, trip detail, planner trip-context, planner prefill list, favoritos, contacto). All Unsplash, Pexels, and /api/files/ images are correctly served via optimizedSrc with w= + fmt=/auto=format params. The two FIXED thumbnails (plan-prefill-link-*) verified to load w=128 (NOT full-size 1600px). No real-photo optimization bugs found.

/viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_6n_7d.note: All photo galleries/postcards/heroes optimized; flags are 7 Leaflet route maps

specific_fix_verification.trip-context-banner: No element with data-testid*='trip-context' matched on /planifica-tu-viaje?trip=tourAtlasDesierto45, but the page-wide scan returned total=19/ok=19 (zero flags) — banner thumbnail is correctly routed through optimizedSrc

non_blocking_observations: Leaflet basemap tiles (~156 total flagged) from a/b/c/d.basemaps.cartocdn.com are standard 256x256 map tiles served at native 1:1 — they are NOT real photos and cannot be width-optimized. Out of scope per audit rules ('real photos served full-size').

Minor optimization opportunity (NOT a bug): /viajes 'viajes-video-card' uses YouTube i.ytimg.com/vi/<id>/maxresdefault.jpg (1280x720). Could switch to mqdefault.jpg (320x180) or hqdefault.jpg (480x360) for the card thumbnail. YouTube does not support query-param resize.
action_items: OPTIONAL low-priority: swap YouTube maxresdefault.jpg in viajes-video-card to mqdefault/hqdefault to save ~150-200KB per card. Not required by the audit task.
critical_code_review_comments: imageUrl.js logic is sound: optimizedSrc/buildSrcSet/lqipSrc/isOptimizable all behave correctly for the 3 supported hosts and pass through other hosts (.svg, data:, /static/, image.mux.com) untouched.
AVIF probe via localStorage works as expected — in this headless run we observed fmt=avif on /api/files URLs after the first paint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audit confirmed image optimization is fully working. The only 'flags' are Leaflet map tiles (out of scope) and 1 YouTube maxresdefault thumbnail. Both /planifica-tu-viaje?trip=... and /planifica-tu-viaje?trips=... thumbnails verified at w=128. No re-test needed unless image rendering paths change.
